items.title: Ant International partners with Visa, Mastercard on developing AI payments
items.summary: Fintech company Ant International announced Thursday it has signed on Visa and Mastercard to collaborate on a new standard for payments made via AI agents, in a bet that they will be used more and more by consumers and businesses.

items.title: Adani Enterprises shares jump as airport unit enters into $1 billion fundraising deal
items.summary: Shares of Adani Enterprises rose nearly 5% Wednesday after its airport unit announced it had entered into a deal to raise about 98.25 billion rupees ($1 billion) from a group of global and domestic investors.

items.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows
items.summary: Chinese companies rushed into electric cars a decade ago, and now they are expanding into humanoid robots as the EV market sees a slowdown amid intense competition.

items.title: U.S. reveals import ban on slew of Canadian goods as trade war escalates
items.summary: The White House said it would ban imports of Canadian motorbikes and a slew of other products starting later this month as diplomatic and trade relations with Ottawa continue to fray.
